content.introduction: The sources indicate that on today's date, November 6, 2026, several companies are scheduled to announce their earnings for Q3 2026. These include Eaton Corporation plc, Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A., Marathon Petroleum Corporation, Booking Holdings Inc., Suncor Energy Inc., AMETEK, Inc., Thomson Reuters Corporation, Keurig Dr Pepper Inc., Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited, Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A., Ferrari N.V., Apollo Global Management, Inc., Energy Transfer LP, and MPLX LP. Notably, Electronic Arts Inc. is scheduled for a Q2 2027 earnings announcement. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for other dates beyond these specified earnings announcements.
